description: For merchants who sell with Capi Agent. Connect your store and ask ChatGPT how sales went today, why they dropped, what needs your attention, and why customers rate the service low — every answer built from your store's real figures. ChatGPT can also set up your AI sales agent for you: add knowledge base answers, adjust its rules, working hours and behaviour, with every change logged and undoable. Customer identities never leave Capi: no names, phone numbers, emails or addresses, and phone numbers and emails inside conversation text are masked. Campaigns are only proposed for your approval — nothing is sent to your customers from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Give me today's briefing: sales, what needs my attention, and stock at risk.
Why did my sales drop compared to last week?
Add to my knowledge base that shipping is free on orders over 200 SAR.
